drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion row: input_schema, steps write-the-business-facts and make-the-checklist with their stage keys); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion for Sunrise Bakery: I am Sam, I sell a weekend bread box for $49 once, I post to Instagram and YouTube twice a day, in USD."

lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: No tool in the live catalog checks the YouTube connection.
values.chosen: Submitted connected false and told the owner to reconnect the channel in the app's connections list.
values.evidence: The setup-a-business row lists "YouTube connection check" among the tools the live catalog lacks.

values.undecided: No live tool stores referral rewards.
values.chosen: Wrote the reward as a record:reward row in the owner's own records.
values.evidence: The setup-a-business row lists "referral reward store" among the tools the live catalog lacks.

alike: a blockers column on a board

instructions: 1. Pour the two example checklist rows into the checklist you already keep (see pour), or let the workflow make list:business-setup-checklist and list:business-setup-gaps itself.

2. Say "Run workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion" with business_name, owner_name, owner_email, first_offer_name, first_offer_price_text, channels, posts_per_day (1 to 5) and currency; it asks for any of these you leave out and never invents one.
3. It writes your answers once to record:business-setup:facts, then makes one checklist row for each of 20 stages (accounts to launch-proof) and runs each stage's own workflow, ticking its row.
4. Read the checklist and the gap list: every row says Done, Not done, Gap, Blocked or Not applicable, and each gap names what no live tool did. Run it again to close the gaps.

worked_examples.title: The business facts are written once
worked_examples.ask: Set up Sunrise Bakery on Trillion.
worked_examples.given: Read from the step in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json: the person gave all 8 required fields, so none is asked for. The step writes record:business-setup:facts at @own-records with business_name "Sunrise Bakery", owner_name "Sam", owner_email "sam@example.com", first_offer_name "Weekend bread box", first_offer_price_text "$49 once", channels ["instagram","youtube"], posts_per_day 2 and currency "USD", then reads it back to confirm each field.

worked_examples.title: The checklist gets one row per stage
worked_examples.given: Read from the step: list:business-setup-checklist is not there yet, so it is written with fields stage, label, status, steps_status, gaps and updated_at; then one row record:setup-stage:<key> is written for each of the 20 stage keys (accounts, social-posting, replies, short-videos, articles, search-engines, landing-page, price-tests, funnel-and-baseline, brand-and-emails, payments, paid-access, course, community, member-billing, onboarding, retention-and-referral, legal-and-support, payment-recovery, launch-proof), each with status "Not done"; list:business-setup-gaps is made the same way.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
